    <script id="imageOverlayModal.html" type="text/ng-template">

<div id="image-overlay-modal"
     data-ng-style="{'width': ctrl.imgWidth, 'visibility': ctrl.imgWidth ? 'visible' : 'hidden'}"

    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="modal-header">

    <!-- Body -->

        <!-- Room Image/Share Icons -->
        <div class="img-wrap">
            <share-pinterest data-media="ctrl.pinterestShareModel.media"
                             data-description="ctrl.pinterestShareModel.description"

                            data-media="ctrl.fbShareModel.media"

                 alt="{{::ctrl.photo.imageAlt}}"
                 title="{{::ctrl.photo.imageAlt}}"
                 image-onload="ctrl.onImageLoad(width, height)" />

        </div>

        <!-- Button controllers for scroll down action -->
        <button class="icon icon-down-arrow scroll-down"
                    data-ng-class="{'hidden': ctrl.hideDetails}"
                    data-ng-click="ctrl.onArrowClick('down')"
                    data-ng-if="ctrl.downArrow"
                    data-target-scroll-id="room-wrap"
                    data-scroll-to-btn
                    data-use-offset-position="true"
                    data-scroll-offset="-50"
                    data-scroll-speed="1000"
                    data-parent-element=".modal"
                    aria-label="Scroll Down"><span class="sr-only">Scroll Down</span></button>
                    
		<!-- Button controllers for scroll up action -->
        <button class="icon icon-up-arrow scroll-down"
                    data-ng-class="{'hidden': ctrl.hideDetails}"
                    data-ng-click="ctrl.onArrowClick('up')"
                    data-ng-if="!ctrl.downArrow"
                    data-target-scroll-id="image-overlay-modal"

                    data-use-offset-position="true"
                    data-scroll-speed="1000"

             data-ng-class="{'hidden': ctrl.hideDetails}"
             id="room-wrap">

                 data-ng-if="::ctrl.photo.name"
                 class="room-header"></div>

            <div class="surface-wrap"
                 data-ng-class="{'wide': ctrl.aspectRatio > 1 && ctrl.imgWidth > ctrl.minTwoColWidth && ctrl.photo.surfaces.length > 1, 'tall': ctrl.aspectRatio <=1 || ctrl.imgWidth <= ctrl.minTwoColWidth || ctrl.photo.surfaces.length <=1 }">

                     ng-class-odd="'odd'"

                        <a class="color-container"
                           data-ng-href="{{::surface.color.cdpColorUrl}}"
                           data-ng-click="ctrl.onLinkClick()">
                            <span data-ng-bind-html="::surface.color.name | bmTrustAsHtml"
                                  class="color-name" id="color-name-{{$index}}"></span>
                            <span data-ng-bind="::surface.color.number"
                                  class="color-number" id="color-number-{{$index}}"></span> <i class="icon-right-arrow"></i>
                        </a>
                        <a data-ng-if="::surface.product && surface.product.number"
                           class="product-container"
                           data-ng-href="{{::surface.product.url}}"
                           data-ng-click="ctrl.onLinkClick()">
                            <i class="icon-paintcan"></i>
                            <span class="product-name"
                                  data-ng-bind-html="::surface.product.name | bmTrustAsHtml"></span> <i class="icon-right-arrow"></i>
                        </a>
                                <div class="buy-sample-button-container"
                                     data-ng-if="surface.color.number"
                                     data-ng-class="{'hidden-xs': !true}">
                                    <a href="javascript:void(0);" id="shop-now-{{$index}}" ng-click="ctrl.openBuySampleModal(surface.color)" class="btn btn-card btn-square" aria-labelledby="shop-now-{{$index}} color-name-{{$index}} color-number-{{$index}}">
                                        <i class="icon icon-shopping-cart"></i>Shop Now
                                    </a>
                                </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

        var focusedElementBeforeDialogOpened;
        var desktopConfigSize = 1024;
        function openDialog(e) {
            focusedElementBeforeDialogOpened = document.activeElement;
            // receiving focus
            if (e.keyCode === 13 || e.type === 'click') {
                ally.when.visibleArea({
                    context: dialog,
                    callback: function (context) {
                        var element = ally.query.firstTabbable({
                            context: context, // context === dialog
                            defaultToContext: true,
                        });
                        element.focus();
                    },
                });
                disabledHandle = ally.maintain.disabled({
                    filter: dialog,
                });
                hiddenHandle = ally.maintain.hidden({
                    filter: dialog,

                tabHandle = ally.maintain.tabFocus({
                    context: dialog,

                keyHandle = ally.when.key({
